Courts · Golf

Lakeside Greens.

An 18-hole members course wrapped around the lake — a calm, beautiful round whenever the mood takes you. Water in play on a third of the holes, true greens, and the clubhouse a short walk away.

The course

Eighteen holes, no pressure.

Our course was designed to reward thought as much as power. Water comes into play on a third of the holes, the greens run true, and the pace is yours — quick nine before dinner or a full, slow round on a Sunday.

It is a place to think, walk and breathe as much as it is to score.

  • 18 lakeside holes
  • Generous member tee times daily
  • Buggies and walking both welcome
  • Caddies available on request
Beyond the round

Practice, coach, unwind.

Launch-monitor lessons

Dial in your swing with real data and our resident golf coaches.

Short-game area

Dedicated chipping and putting greens to sharpen the shots that score.

Driving range

Covered, floodlit bays so you can practise in any weather, any hour.

Member tee times

Generous daily tee times, walk or ride, with caddies on request.

Clubhouse steps away

Finish your round on the lakeside terrace with something well earned.

Quiet by design

A calm, uncrowded course — a place to think and breathe as much as to play.

On the course

A round worth the walk.
